snippet.title: PASTDARK – Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
PASTDARK is a horror extraction game with CO-OP up to 4 players with a twist - MADNESS! This makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you!

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4483960/Urbex/
